note: Rituales de comunidad: formatos recurrentes con nombre, para crear hábito. weekday: 0=lunes … 6=domingo. Solo en posts tipo 'reel'. Las OCASIONES tienen prioridad. DESDE 2026-09-21: máximo 1 ritual por semana (se alternan), porque antes caían lunes Y sábado y se comían los formatos ganadores (drama/humor/opinion). Los briefs ya NO imponen su propio CTA ni prohíben nombrar el avión: el CTA lo manda la rotación guardar/compartir/comentar de las voice_rules, y el avión SÍ debe nombrarse en topic/visual_prompt para que la imagen corresponda.

rituals.name: Mystery Monday
rituals.brief: MYSTERY MONDAY — recurring weekly guessing game. Open the caption with 'Mystery Monday ✈️' and frame the aircraft as a challenge to identify. IMPORTANT: name the exact aircraft in `topic` and `visual_prompt` (the footage must match), but keep the CAPTION as a guess — reveal the name only at the end, as the payoff. The post's assigned CTA type (save / share / comment) still governs the closing line: on a guess-heavy day that will usually be COMMENT, but if this post was assigned SAVE or SHARE, honour that instead.

rituals.name: Spotter Saturday
rituals.brief: SPOTTER SATURDAY — recurring ritual where the FOLLOWERS are the stars. Open with 'Spotter Saturday 📸' and celebrate the spotting community. Name the aircraft shown in `topic` and `visual_prompt` so the footage matches. The post's assigned CTA type (save / share / comment) governs the closing line — do not force 'drop your shot & tag' every week; vary it so the ritual stays fresh.
